data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to create native Android floating windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget and API to open a native Android floating window from Flutter code. The window can display any Flutter UI and behaves like an overlay on top of other apps.
use_when: You need an overlay/floating window on Android devices
You want to display custom Flutter UI outside the main app UI
avoid_when: Your app must run on iOS or other platforms
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native code
strengths: Simple API to open and control the window
Runs as a native Android window for better performance
Allows any Flutter widget as window content
weaknesses: Requires native build steps (pigeon, Android setup)
data.setup_notes: Run `flutter pub run pigeon --input lib/pigeon.dart` to generate platform code and ensure Android project is configured for a plugin; no extra permissions required but native setup is needed.
